reasoning: AhKs = TPTK on Ad8c2h (rainbow). Hero is HU PFA on a dry A-high range-c-bet board, BB checked. Per HU carve-out (v3.4 line 729), bet for value/protection: extract from worse Ax, weak pairs, overcards; deny equity to backdoor draws. Standard small range c-bet sizing.

AhKs TPTK on Ad8c4h (rainbow). HU PFA on dry A-high; BB checked. Standard range c-bet small for value + protection vs underpairs and backdoor draws. Brick swap from 3h to 4h doesn't change board character.
AhKs TPTK on Ad8c5h (rainbow). HU PFA on dry A-high; BB checked. Brick 5h still leaves a dry rainbow with no straight or flush threat. Small c-bet for value/protection per HU carve-out.
AhKs TPTK on Ad8c6h (rainbow). HU PFA, dry A-high. Small c-bet for value (worse Ax, 8x, underpairs call) + protection. Range advantage strong.
AhKs TPTK on Ad8c7h (rainbow). 7h adds slight backdoor straight texture (98 BDOESD) but board remains essentially dry. Small HU c-bet for value + protection.
AhKs TPTK on Ad8c3h (canonical), HU PFA, 60bb effective. Shallower stacks if anything increase BET incentive (less reverse-implied risk). Small range c-bet for value/protection.
AhKs TPTK on Ad8c3h, 105bb effective (near-standard). HU PFA dry A-high range-c-bet. Small value/protection bet.
AhKs TPTK on Ad8c3h, 150bb deep. Even deep, HU PFA on dry A-high range-c-bets small for value + protection — TPTK plays well across street tree at any reasonable stack depth.

AhKs TPTK on Ad8c3h in a 3-bet pot (BB opens, hero 3bets, BB calls). 3-bet pot SPR is lower; TPTK still value-bets small in HU 3-bet pot on dry A-high — hero is range-uncapped and dominates BB's calling range. Small-to-medium c-bet.
AhKs TPTK on Ad8c3h in a limp-then-iso line. Hero remains the aggressor with TPTK on dry A-high HU. Small c-bet for value/protection — the action history change does not alter the optimal flop play.

9d9c = set of 9s on river runout 9h7s2c4d3c — set holds, no flush (3 clubs not 4), no straight completes from low cards. BB has called twice and checked river — BB's range is heavy with second pair (7x), pocket pairs, missed draws. Thin value bet extracts from those calls; checking back gives up too much.

9d9c on 9h7s2c4d4c — board pairs the 4, hero now has 9s full of 4s (boat). Monster on a paired runout. BET for value — BB's calls down with 7x, FD-misses, overpairs all pay off; checking back forfeits river value with the absolute nuts (only 44 quads beats hero, near-impossible from BB's preflop call range).

9d9c on 9h7s2c4d5c — set still holds; no straight completes (need 36 for 3-4-5-6-7, very rare in BB call range). BB's range after twice-call + check has 7x, second-pair, missed draws. Thin value bet — set extracts from worse pairs.

9d9c on 9h7s2c4d6c — set still holds; small straight possible (3-4-5-6-7 needs 35; 4-5-6-7-8 needs 58 OESD complete). Light scare card but hero still ahead of BB's range (7x, FD-misses, weak pairs). Thin value bet for the same range; size down 33% to keep BB's worse pairs in.

9d9c on 9h7s2c4d7c — board pairs 7 making hero 9s full of 7s (boat). Monster runout. BET for value — BB's 7x (now trips of 7s) calls, sets of lower pairs, FD-misses pay off. Use larger sizing given boat strength.

9d9c set on canonical 9h7s2c4dJh river, 60bb effective. Set of 9s is value vs BB's two-call range (7x, missed FDs, weak Jx that floated turn). Thin value bet — checking forfeits river value at low SPR.
9d9c set on 9h7s2c4dJh river, 105bb effective. Same logic as canonical: set is value vs BB's bet-bet-call line capped at 7x/Jx/draws. Small thin value bet 33%.
9d9c set on 9h7s2c4dJh river, 150bb deep. Deeper stacks don't change river value extraction — BB's range is the same; bet 33% for thin value.
9d9c set on 9h7s2c4dJh in a 3-bet pot. SPR compressed; set is monster value vs BB's 3-bet-call and twice-call range. Larger value sizing in 3-bet pot to extract from overpairs/Jx.
9d9c set on 9h7s2c4dJh, limp-then-iso line. Action history changes preflop ranges modestly but set on safe runout with passive river check is still a thin value bet.

KhQd = TPGK on KcTc2d. HU PFA on a two-tone draw-heavy K-high board (FD live + JQ, J9 OESDs). Per HU carve-out, bet for value AND protection — charge clubs and straight draws, get called by worse Kx/Tx/draws. Larger sizing 66% appropriate on draw-heavy texture.
KhQd TPGK on KcTc3d. Two-tone draw-heavy K-high; FD live, OESD live (QJ, J9). HU PFA value+protection bet, 66% to charge draws.
KhQd TPGK on KcTc4d. Two-tone draw-heavy. Same protection logic — FD + OESD live. 66% sizing for value/protection.
KhQd TPGK on KcTc5d. Two-tone draw-heavy. FD + JQ OESD + J9 OESD live. Value + protection bet 66%.
KhQd TPGK on KcTc7d. Two-tone draw-heavy; 7d adds 89 OESD (8-9-T-J slot). FD + multiple straight draws live. Value/protection bet 66%.
KhQd TPGK on canonical KcTc6d, 60bb effective. Compressed stacks favour committed value/protection bet; 66% on draw-heavy two-tone.
KhQd TPGK on KcTc6d, 105bb. Standard depth. HU PFA value/protection bet 66% — charge FD and OESDs (J9, QJ, 87, 98 etc).
KhQd TPGK on KcTc6d, 150bb deep. Deeper stacks make denying equity to draws even more important; large c-bet 66% for value/protection.
KhQd TPGK on KcTc6d in a 3-bet pot. SPR compressed; TPGK is range-top in 3-bet pot. Bet smaller (33%) due to compressed SPR, but still bet for value/protection in HU 3-bet pot on draw-heavy K-high.
KhQd TPGK on KcTc6d, limp-then-iso line. Action history shifts preflop ranges modestly, but TPGK on draw-heavy two-tone HU still bets large for value/protection 66%.

TsTd = overpair on 8h5c2d2c turn (board now paired 22). Bucket: strong-made (overpair on paired board). Facing IP 33% probe HU at SPR ~5. TT is ahead of villain's probe range (8x, 5x, draws, light bluffs) but loses to 22 trips and rare 88/55 boats. CALL — pot odds 25% easily met by overpair equity; raising bloats vs the few trips. Plan: check-call most river bricks.

TsTd overpair on 8h5c2d3c turn — straight-draw possible (4 makes 2-3-4-5; 6 makes wheel-extension etc). Bucket: strong-made (overpair). Facing 33% IP probe HU. CALL with overpair — beats 8x/5x and most probe range; raise risks bloating vs sets/two-pair from villain's slow flop check-back.

TsTd overpair on 8h5c2d4c turn — wheel/straights live (3 makes 2-3-4-5-6 needs 6; 36 makes wheel; 67 OESD live). Bucket: strong-made overpair. Facing IP 33% probe; CALL — overpair holds vs probe range, raise bloats vs the now-completed straights from BB's pre-flop range.

TsTd overpair on 8h5c2d6c turn — straight texture (47, 79 OESDs, 34 makes 3-4-5-6 OESD). Bucket: strong-made overpair facing IP 33% probe HU. CALL captures overpair value; raise bloats vs the connected straight texture.

TsTd overpair on 8h5c2d7c turn — straight (5-6-7-8 needs 64 or 96) live; 8s pair on board. Bucket: strong-made overpair. Facing IP probe 33%; CALL — overpair sufficient vs probe range, raise risks committing into wider straight equity.

TsTd = TURNED SET on canonical 8h5c2dTc turn, 65bb effective. Monster on rainbow safe turn. Facing IP 33% probe HU; RAISE to charge value (overpairs JJ-AA, 8x two-pair) and protect vs gutshots/draws. Per KB §1.7 default for sets, raise extracts at compressed SPR.

TsTd turned set on 8h5c2dTc turn, 100bb effective. Monster on safe rainbow. Facing 33% IP probe HU; RAISE for value/protection — extracts from villain's bet-call range (overpairs, 8x, draws). Solver-aligned turn raise size ~75%.

TsTd turned set on 8h5c2dTc turn, 150bb deep. Monster on safe rainbow, deep stacks reward building the pot with sets. RAISE for value vs probe — overpairs, 8x, 5x, FDs all continue. 75% turn raise size.

TsTd turned set on 8h5c2dTc, facing smaller probe (~22% pot). Monster on safe rainbow. Smaller probe = wider villain range; RAISE extracts from a wider call-down list (overpairs, second pair, draws). Raise to ~3x the probe.

TsTd turned set on 8h5c2dTc, facing larger probe (~50% pot). Monster on safe rainbow. Larger probe is more polarized but still RAISE — set is far ahead of villain's probe-bigger range (overpairs, KT/JT for top pair, 8x); raise charges and builds pot. Slightly more cautious due to polarization, but value > pot-control with set.

AhJh on Jc9c5d2s2c — board pairs 22 on river. Hero now has two pair Js+22 with A kicker. Bucket: strong-made (two pair). Facing BTN polar 75% river bet HU. Two-pair with A blocker bluff-catches well vs BTN's polarized range — value is sets/boats only (88/55/22 unlikely from BTN, JJ unlikely as 3bet); bluffs are missed clubs/straight draws. CALL.

AhJh TPGK on Jc9c5d2s3c. No new straights/flushes complete (3 of 4 clubs only). Hero TPGK with A blocker bluff-catches BTN's polar 75% river bet HU. Bluffs include missed FDs (Ac-Xc minus Ah), missed straight draws (T8, KT). A-blocker reduces nut-FD bluff combo count slightly but TP+A-kicker is at the top of BB's check-call-call range. CALL.

AhJh TPGK on Jc9c5d2s4c. No straight completes, no flush. TPGK with A blocker — bluff-catch HU vs polar 75%. CALL: A-blocker + top pair good kicker is the top of hero's range; folding TPGK to a 75% bet on a brick river is over-folding.

AhJh TPGK on Jc9c5d2s5c — board pairs 5. Hero has TP A-kicker; trips of 5s only (55, very rare from BTN open) beat hero. Bluff-catch with TP good kicker + A blocker vs polar 75% HU; CALL — top of range.
AhJh TPGK on Jc9c5d2s6c. No straight (5-6-7-8-9 needs 78, 6-7-8-9-T needs 78T). No flush. TP A-kicker with A blocker is a strong bluff-catcher vs BTN's polar 75% river bet HU. CALL.

AhJh on canonical Jc9c5d2sQd river, 60bb effective. Q overcard turns hero's J-pair into 2nd pair, but A blocker remains. Pot 50, to call 37.5; at 60bb effective hero is committed. CALL — A-blocker + 2nd pair has enough bluff-catch equity vs BTN polar 75% (KT, T8 straights are value but missed FDs/AcKx/QcXc bluffs balance). Close decision.

AhJh on Jc9c5d2sQd river, 100bb effective. Q overcard demotes J-pair to 2nd pair. BTN polar 75% river bet HU has value range KT/T8 straights, QQ, JJ (rare), 99-trips-on-Jrunout (no), Qx; bluffs are missed FDs and overcards. With A-blocker reducing A-high bluff combos slightly but nut-blocker logic mixed, CALL is the protocol-default for bluff-catch with showdown value at this price. Close.

AhJh on Jc9c5d2sQd river, 155bb deep. Same range analysis as canonical: 2nd pair + A blocker bluff-catches BTN polar 75% HU. Deeper stacks don't change pot-odds math; CALL is protocol-default close decision.

AhJh on Jc9c5d2sQd river facing smaller bet (~50% pot, to_call 24.8). Pot odds ~25%; far below 37.5%. With 2nd pair + A blocker, CALL is clear at this lower threshold — even tightened polar value range can't make this a fold at 25% pot odds.

AhJh on Jc9c5d2sQd river facing OVERBET (to_call 56.2 ≈ 112% pot, pot odds ~34.6%). BTN's overbet-polar value range is very narrow (sets, KT/T8 straights, QQ, JJ) and bluff frequency is structurally lower at overbet sizing. 2nd pair with A blocker has insufficient bluff-catch equity vs the densified overbet value range. FOLD — overbet narrows villain past A-blocker compensation.
